movelist.name: Photon Geyser
movelist.effect: This attack uses the highest of the user’s Attack or Special Attack Stat, though it remains a Special Move. This Move ignores any Abilities that would cause it to fail or miss, such as Dodge or Wonder Guard; those Abilities cannot be activated in response to Photon Geyser.

movelist.name: Autotomize
movelist.effect: For the remainder of the Encounter, the user’s Weight Class is one value lower, to a minimum of 1. If the user can, the user’s Speed is raised by +2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Psycho Cut
movelist.effect: Psycho Cut is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Gravity
movelist.effect: For 5 rounds, the area is considered Warped. While Warped, Moves that involve the user being airborne may not be used. Pokémon cannot use Sky or Levitate Capabilities to end their turn at an altitude higher than 1 meter. Flying-Types and Pokémon with the Ability Levitate no longer resist Ground-Type Moves, and Pokémon cannot use Sky or Levitate Capabilities for immunity to Moves with the Groundsource keyword. All Accuracy Rolls receive a +2 Bonus.

movelist.name: Night Slash
movelist.effect: Night Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+

abilities.name: Prism Armor
abilities.effect: The user gains +5 Damage Reduction against Super Effective-Damage. Defensive.

abilities.name: Sunglow
abilities.effect: The user may activate Sunglow while exposed to sunlight to become Radiant. As a Swift Action, the user may expend the Radiant condition to gain +2 Attack CS and +2 Accuracy for the rest of the Scene.

abilities.name: Beam Cannon
abilities.effect: The Effect Range and Critical Hit Range of the user’s Ranged, 1-Target Moves are increased by 3.
